title: doco-cd deployment configuration
description: Schema for the doco-cd deployment configuration file (.doco-cd.yaml / .doco-cd.yml)

name.description: Name of the Docker Compose deployment / stack. Required unless auto_discover is enabled.

repository_url.description: HTTP(S) or SSH URL of the Git repository to deploy from. Defaults to the repository that triggered the webhook.

webhook_filter.description: Regular expression to whitelist deployment triggers based on the webhook event payload (e.g., branch or tag reference).

reference.description: Git reference to deploy (branch, tag, or full ref). Defaults to 'refs/heads/main'.

working_dir.description: Working directory for the deployment, relative to the repository root. Defaults to '.'.

compose_files.description: List of Docker Compose files to use. Defaults to standard Compose file names.

environment.description: Map of environment variables to use for variable interpolation in the Compose files.

env_files.description: List of dotenv files to use for variable interpolation. Defaults to ['.env'].

remove_orphans.description: Remove containers for services not defined in the Compose file. Defaults to true.

prune_images.description: Remove images that are no longer used after deployment. Defaults to true.

force_recreate.description: Force recreation of containers even if the configuration has not changed. Defaults to false.

force_image_pull.description: Always pull the latest version of the specified image tags if a newer version is available. Defaults to false.

timeout.description: Time in seconds to wait for the deployment to finish before timing out. Defaults to 180.

force_image_pull.description: Always attempt to pull a newer version of the base image during build. Defaults to false.

quiet.description: Suppress the build output. Defaults to false.

args.description: Map of build-time arguments to pass to the build process.

no_cache.description: Disable the use of the cache when building images. Defaults to false.

destroy.description: Remove the deployment and all its resources from the Docker host. Defaults to false.

remove_volumes.description: Remove the volumes used by the deployment. Defaults to true.

remove_images.description: Remove the images used by the deployment (not supported in Docker Swarm mode). Defaults to true.

remove_dir.description: Remove the repository directory after the deployment is destroyed. Defaults to true.

profiles.description: List of Docker Compose profiles to activate for the deployment.

external_secrets.description: Maps environment variable names to external secret references for secret providers (e.g. Bitwarden, 1Password, AWS Secrets Manager, webhook store).

oneOf.description: Legacy scalar reference used by non-webhook secret providers (e.g. a UUID or secret ID).

auto_discover.description: Enable autodiscovery of services to deploy by scanning subdirectories of the working directory for Docker Compose files. Defaults to false.

depth.description: Maximum depth of subdirectories to scan for Docker Compose files. Defaults to 0 (unlimited).

delete.description: Remove obsolete auto-discovered deployments that are no longer present in the repository. Defaults to true.

externalSecretRef.description: Structured external secret reference used by the webhook secret provider.

store_ref.description: Name of the global webhook secret store to use, as defined in the store YAML file.

remote_ref.description: Key/value pairs substituted into the store's URL, headers, body and json_path templates at resolution time.
